text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
A losing streak... Trainer,
I'm starting to lose sight of what to do.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've always had a sense of it somehow.
Like a core principle I always believe in.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Whenever things didn't go well,
I tried to return to that place.
However...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Right now, that core is... a little vague.
Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The very instincts I relied on for so long
might have been wrong all along.
choice_data_list: Let's believe in all our hard work!
Shall we switch things up a bit?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
This core wasn't built in a day.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Running, running, putting in the miles... in the middle of all that, something finally stirred inside me...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(If I start doubting this,
then it means I truly have nothing left. In that case—)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll believe—
one more time. Especially now, when the results aren't showing!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. I don't think it's all completely bad. But..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It's not as if there's nothing we can change.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Don't be a coward...
There must be something. Even if it breaks my form, there are parts I still have to polish.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I—I'm going to change.
I'll show you I can change.
Even if it's little by little, for the better.
